---
title: "invalid_payload"
description: "The message's payload does not match its schema."
---

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mts from the website's docs. Do not edit: run `pnpm docs:gen`. -->

**What happened:** The message's payload does not match its schema.

**How to fix it:** Fix the fields named in `details` (Zod issues) and send the message again.

Returned (not thrown) as a refusal: `{ ok: false, code, message, expected?, details?, docs }` from `send()`, `simulate().send` and the WebSocket `__error` frame; thrown by `testActor` as a `RefusalError`.

The error's `message` names the specifics (the message, state, binding or value involved). See all [error codes](/errors/).
